core_obligations: Kernel description: the coinvariants of the subquotient are the kernel of the natural map between the coinvariants of the two quotients, and this map is identified with a map between the displayed fibre products (proof lines 3599-3605).

Restriction to a summand: restrict the map to the second summand of the source and analyse its behaviour on the filtration quotients, comparing the images with the filtration of the target (proof lines 3605-3615).
Conclusion: the compatibility of the two filtrations identifies the kernel with the stated fibre product, which is the assertion (proof lines 3615-3621).
